description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing access control policies in Mattermost, including fetching, creating, deleting, searching, and updating policies and related entities.

methods.name: getAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Fetches an access control policy by ID, optionally for a specific channel.

methods.name: createAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Creates a new access control policy and dispatches success or handles errors.

methods.name: deleteAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Deletes an access control policy by ID.

methods.name: searchAccessControlPolicies
methods.description: Searches for access control policies based on search term, type, and pagination.

methods.name: searchAccessControlPolicyChannels
methods.description: Searches for channels associated with a specific access control policy.

methods.name: assignChannelsToAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Assigns channels to a specific access control policy.

methods.name: unassignChannelsFromAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Removes channels from a specific access control policy.

methods.name: getAccessControlFields
methods.description: Retrieves access control fields with optional filtering.

methods.name: searchUsersForExpression
methods.description: Tests an access control expression against users and dispatches user profiles.

methods.name: getVisualAST
methods.description: Converts an expression to a visual format (AST).

methods.name: validateExpressionAgainstRequester
methods.description: Validates an expression against the requester context.

methods.name: createAccessControlSyncJob
methods.description: Creates a synchronization job for access control policies.

methods.name: updateAccessControlPoliciesActive
methods.description: Updates the active state of multiple access control policies.
